industries.title: Solutions Across Every Sector
industries.subtitle: From raw material intake to finished product release, Askara supports quality and safety testing across key industries.

items.title: Food & Beverage
items.desc: Compositional analysis, nutritional labeling, and contaminant screening for packaged food and beverage manufacturers, from raw material intake to finished product release.

items.title: Fish & Seafood
items.desc: Histamine, heavy metal, and freshness testing for seafood processors and exporters, supporting compliance with international food safety and export standards.

items.title: Food Manufacturing
items.desc: In-process and finished-goods quality control for large-scale manufacturing lines, helping plants catch deviations before they reach the production floor or the shelf.

items.title: Laboratory / Testing
items.desc: Instrumentation, reagents, and reference support for independent and in-house testing laboratories that need accurate, repeatable analytical results.

items.title: Environmental
items.desc: Wastewater treatment and process water purification for facilities that need to meet environmental discharge standards, alongside high-purity laboratory water.
